name: visuals
description: HTML decks, dashboards, infographics, Markdown-to-scroll-decks, and Excalidraw architecture diagrams from any content.
skillInstructions:
Kimi Code tool mapping for the visuals skills.

The authoritative mapping lives in the sibling repo `dEitY719/harness-skills` at `references/kimi-tools.md` (https://github.com/dEitY719/harness-skills/blob/main/references/kimi-tools.md) — read it when a skill names a tool you do not recognise. It is the single source of truth for every repo in the `dEitY719/*-skills` family; do not copy it into this repo. Summary:

- Read / Write / Edit / Bash / Grep / Glob keep their exposed Kimi names. Search contents with `Grep`; match paths with `Glob`.
- `TodoWrite` -> Kimi Code's `TodoList` tool.
- "Ask the user" -> `AskUserQuestion`. `visuals:visualize` uses it for the Auto-Recommend step (propose one or two formats, wait for the answer), and `visuals:md-to-scrolldeck` uses it when a document yields fewer than 5 beats or more than 20.
- "Dispatch a subagent" -> `Agent` with `subagent_type: "coder"` (writes files) or `"explore"` (read-only). Never pass `general-purpose`.
- Progressive disclosure is literal: `Read` the named `references/` file at the step that names it. Do not preload a skill's whole `references/` tree.
- All three skills write exactly one output file per run and must not echo the generated HTML or JSON back into chat — see each skill's Bedrock-safe-write note. Use a single `Write` call for the whole file.
- `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` is a Claude Code variable and is unset in Kimi Code. Wherever a skill writes it — `excalidraw-diagram`'s render command and both HTML skills' `lib/verify-html.sh` call — substitute the directory this plugin was installed into, the one holding `skills/` and `lib/`.
- `visuals:excalidraw-diagram` Step 5 shells out to `uv run python render_excalidraw.py` and then reads the PNG back. If image reading is unavailable, say so and skip the visual audit rather than claiming 27/27 quality items passed.

interface.shortDescription: HTML decks, scroll decks, and Excalidraw diagrams from any content
interface.longDescription: Visuals bundles the three skills that turn content into something you can show: visualize (single-file HTML decks, dashboards, infographics, posters), md-to-scrolldeck (a Markdown report into a vertical scroll-snap deck), and excalidraw-diagram (.excalidraw JSON that argues visually, rendered and self-audited).
